# Hook payload fixtures

One payload per case, exactly as Claude Code sent it on stdin (2.1.294, Windows).
Generated by `spike/make_fixtures.py` from `tests/sessions/`; paths use `<HOME>` and
`<SANDBOX>` placeholders (tests swap `<SANDBOX>` for a temp folder).

| File | From | Covers |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `post_read.json` | notes-windows | CAP-1: file text in tool_response.file, no line prefixes |
| `post_grep_content.json` | repo-windows | CAP-1: rel\path:line:text lines; numFiles 0 |
| `post_bash.json` | repo-windows | CAP-1: stdout/stderr only; source from the command |
| `post_webfetch.json` | web-windows | CAP-3: summary in result, raw size in bytes |
| `post_websearch.json` | web-windows | CAP-5: {title, url} results |
| `post_glob.json` | inject-windows | ignored tool: capture must skip it |
| `post_toolsearch.json` | web-windows | ignored tool: capture must skip it |
| `post_read_subagent.json` | interactive-windows | CAP-6: agent_id and agent_type present |
| `session_start_startup.json` | notes-windows | startup |
| `session_start_compact.json` | interactive-windows | INJ-3: after /compact |
| `pre_compact.json` | interactive-windows | trigger: manual |
| `stop.json` | repo-windows | VER-1: last_assistant_message, stop_hook_active |
| `subagent_stop_internal.json` | interactive-windows | helper agent: must be ignored |
| `subagent_stop_explore.json` | interactive-windows | real subagent |
| `message_display_partial.json` | interactive-windows | REP-1: one paragraph, not final |
| `message_display_final.json` | interactive-windows | REP-1: last delta |
| `user_prompt_submit.json` | notes-windows | prompt_id keys the turn |
| `post_mcp.json` | synthetic | CAP-1: MCP response is a list of {type, text} blocks |
| `malformed.txt` | synthetic | NFR-7: invalid JSON (bad \U escape); hook logs and exits 0 |
| `empty.txt` | synthetic | NFR-7: empty stdin |
